edits.before: Aim for pH 6–6.5; test before liming and avoid over-liming.
New Zealand spinach is a separate, frost-tender summer substitute for hot weather; perpetual spinach (spinach beet) is a leaf beet.
edits.after: New Zealand spinach is a separate, frost-tender summer substitute for hot weather, usually sold simply as ‘New Zealand spinach’ without a variety name. Perpetual spinach (spinach beet) is a leaf beet.

additionalVarieties.name: New Zealand spinach
additionalVarieties.text: Heat-tolerant but frost-tender; a spreading summer alternative. Cook the tender shoots in water and discard the water.
